steps.prompt: Before the check: which pattern from Smart Multiplication do you use most, and which do you still have to think about?

cards.title: Near a power of ten: quick review
cards.body: $\times 9$, $\times 99$, $\times 999$: multiply by $10$, $100$ or $1000$, then take one lot away. $\times 98$: times $100$, take two lots away.

cards.title: Digit patterns: quick review
cards.body: $\times 11$: put the sum of the digits in the middle, carrying if needed. $\times 101$: write a two-digit number twice. $\times 1001$: write a three-digit number twice.

cards.title: How the check works
cards.body: First a short warm-up. Then the check: $8$ questions, easiest first, no hints. Type each answer. You need all $8$ right to pass. If you miss one, you’ll see how to do it, and the next try gives you new numbers.

prompts: Where could you use a pattern from Smart Multiplication outside school?
